meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 它会先说“HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”,然后作为 Lead 组建 5 个互为敌对的成员团队做交叉批评,只保留经得起攻击的洞察,并强制交给 `plan` agent 写成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你提到“hyperplan”、“hpp”等关键词,或规划需要最大严谨度、暴露薄弱假设与过度设计时触发;需已开启 team-mode 并在主会话中以 lead 身份运行。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我做这次规划
say.note: 会启动 5 人敌对团队交叉批评

say.text: hpp:把这个方案里过度设计的部分挑出来
say.note: 成员互相攻击,只留站得住的洞察

say.text: 对这次重构做一次 adversarial plan
say.note: 结束时会强制转交 plan agent

howto.what_en: It first says "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!", then leads 5 mutually hostile team members through cross-critique, keeps only defensible insights, and mandatorily hands them to the `plan` agent to write an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "hyperplan", "hpp" etc., or when planning needs maximum rigor and must surface weak assumptions, blind spots and over-engineering; requires team-mode and a main-session lead run.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan for this planning task
say_en.note: Spawns a 5-member hostile team for cross-critique

say_en.text: hpp: strip the over-engineering from this design
say_en.note: Members attack each other; only defensible insights survive

say_en.text: Do an adversarial plan for this refactor
say_en.note: Ends with a mandatory handoff to the plan agent
